subject: Kickoff: AtlasAI Trial — Prompt samples, logs & acceptance criteria
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@atlasai.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir.rao@atlasai.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: AtlasAI Trial — Prompt samples, logs & acceptance criteria

Hi Olivia / Samir —

Great to meet both of you on the call today. Short recap + concrete next steps so we stay aligned for the 4-week trial: 

1) Success criteria (agreed on call) — please confirm but our read is: 
   - Precision: average top-1 relevance >= 78% on your labeled validation set
   - Latency: 95th percentile inference <= 280ms at target concurrency (10 rps)
   - Throughput/cost: token cost <= $0.0009 per token-equivalent under steady-state
   - Integration: end-to-end inference via API with your sample batch jobs integrated by week 3

2) Data we need from AtlasAI by EOD Wed (2028-03-14):
   - Prompt samples: 1,200 anonymized prompt rows (CSV) representing production mix; include a column with "expected_output"/labels where available
   - Log samples: 48–72 hours of request/response logs (anonymized) or a 10k-sample export; if PII present, please redact or share through our secure transfer (instructions attached)
   - Priority flows: list of top 3 user journeys to prioritize for eval

3) Ownership & timeline:
   - AtlasAI delivery: Olivia (deliver attachments + secure transfer link) — due 2028-03-14
   - Redwood data intake + QA: Marissa Cole — 2028-03-16
   - Eval plan & metric definition: Ben Carter (lead) + Diego (oversight) — draft by 2028-03-18
   - Integration test & internal smoke: Redwood infra — week of 2028-03-20

4) Security/compliance note: If the logs contain sensitive attributes, please use the password-protected transfer or S3 presigned link with KMS encryption. We will not persist raw logs beyond the trial retention window (30 days) unless you request otherwise.

5) Next call: Proposal review + intake confirmation — Thursday 2028-03-16 at 10:00 PT (I’ll send the invite once you confirm).

Attachments: data-transfer-instructions.pdf (transfer checklist + encryption guidance).

Thanks — excited to get started.

Best,
Diego
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
--
Redwood Inference | diego.fernandez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@atlasai.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir.rao@atlasai.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Mar 2028 09:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Kickoff: AtlasAI Trial — Prompt samples, logs & acceptance criteria

Thanks Diego — great summary. Quick confirmations and a data drop plan: 

- Success criteria: agreed with the tweaks below — we’ll accept top-1 >= 75% (label coverage for some flows is limited), and we may relax cost target if overall latency improves significantly. Will confirm final thresholds in the noon sync on Wed.

- Data delivery: attaching a representative prompt sample (atlasai_prompt_samples_v1.csv). This file has 1,050 rows; we will follow up with an additional 200 rows by tomorrow. For logs, security prefers we use your SFTP endpoint. Samir will coordinate.

- Security: we cannot share raw user IDs. All user identifiers have been hashed; PII columns removed. We’ll provide a short mapping doc for flow IDs.

Attachment: atlasai_prompt_samples_v1.csv (sample), note that the file contains columns: flow_id, user_message, expected_output, priority_flag.

Looking forward to the next steps — sending the SFTP creds to Marissa and Samir in a separate secure message.

—Olivia
Senior Product Manager, AtlasAI

Marissa —

We created a time-limited SFTP bucket: sftp.atlasai.com/redwood-poc/ (expires 2028-04-15). Credentials will be sent in a separate secure email. We dropped the prompt sample attached to the earlier email; logs upload will follow tonight (10k request sample). Please confirm when you see the file.

Thanks,
Samir

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <samir.rao@atlasai.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Mar 2028 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: AtlasAI Trial — Prompt samples, logs & acceptance criteria

Thanks Samir / Diego — I pulled the prompt sample from SFTP this morning and ran a quick QA pass. Notes: 

- File integrity: 1,050 rows received; CSV encoding looks clean. I validated header columns and found 14 rows where "expected_output" was empty — I flagged those in a QA sheet (link below).
- Label quality: several labels appear to be macro-level outcomes rather than canonical single-line outputs; for evaluation we’ll map those to the canonical label set and document mapping in the eval spec.
- Missing metadata: flow_id mapping requested — Samir, when you share the flow mapping doc we’ll attach it to the eval plan.

Next steps on our side: 
- Ben and I will draft the evaluation harness (scoring script + metric definitions) by Friday 2028-03-18.
- Diego, I’ll need the target concurrency numbers you expect to test (10 rps? burst to 20?) to include realistic load in the smoke tests.
- Once Ben posts the scoring script, we’ll run an initial baseline with Redwood-verified model configuration and report metrics back to you within 48 hours.

Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/POC-3982?focusedCommentId=12345 (QA notes + mapping sheet).

Marissa Cole
Data Intake Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@atlasai.com>, Samir Rao <samir.rao@atlasai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: AtlasAI Trial — Prompt samples, logs & acceptance criteria

Perfect — appreciate the quick turnaround. Two final confirmations before the Thursday sync: 

1) Test profile: we’ll run the baseline at target concurrency 10 rps with a 60s warmup and 5-minute steady window; we’ll also run a single short burst test to 20 rps. Please confirm that reflects your expected production pattern.

2) Acceptance thresholds (tentative): top-1 >= 76% (AtlasAI accepts 75–78 range); 95th pctl latency <= 300ms (Redwood will report both including and excluding cold starts); cost guidance is informational — we’ll report tokenized cost and recommended batching/quantization options.

I'll share the calendar invite for Thursday 2028-03-16 10:00 PT and include the scoring script artifact once Ben posts it (Ben — ping if you need more samples / label clarifications).

Thanks all — see you Thursday.

Diego
